first_attempt.correction: Unique checkpoint filenames; detect error dialogs immediately; short full-workflow rehearsal before rerunning.

preliminary_setup: Runner module-name collision and unavailable environment discovery were corrected before measurement. Python formatting preserved its syntax tree.
limitations: One ten-minute session plus 20 restarts, not leak freedom or multi-hour endurance.
Two-second resource samples can miss transient peaks and processes between polls.
CPU uses sampled cumulative process time, expressed relative to one logical core; measurement tools excluded.
Working sets include shared pages and are reported per process role, not as unique total physical RAM.
Default two-range fixture and one Windows host; no stress saturation, laptop, or other-hardware claim.
Latency includes decoding and policy evaluation after control acknowledgement, not human rendering or remote delivery.
Desktop approval state was unchanged; unapproved ranges correctly require Review.
The retained export is the recent window, not the entire session.
